purpose: Candidate native send and stream contracts; no conversation POST, observer ping or live SSE capture has run

send.parent: Preparation and send share the same parent_message_id; continuation sends include the server conversation_id
send.messages: Each carries a stable id, author role, creation time and content object; text is content_type=text with parts array
send.identity: Routed managed authentication; native session device/profile headers retained
send.persistence: history_and_training_disabled explicitly selected; never toggled for handoff recovery
send.retry_policy: Native implementation must not copy the browser automatic POST retry path

observer_ping.token: Raw native observer snapshot in OpenAI-Sentinel-SO-Token for this application flow; not the separate SentinelSDK wrapper protocol
observer_ping.headers: Requirements/prepare, turnstile and proof tokens as available; OpenAI-Sentinel-Extra-Data is base64 JSON with + replaced by - and / by _, retaining padding
observer_ping.metadata: v=1, sequence_number, signal presence flags and ping_source; conversation_id/last_message_id only when known
observer_ping.acceptance: Not attempted; HTTP success would not establish message acceptance

delta_v1.activation: event=delta_encoding, data=v1; delta before activation is invalid
delta_v1.inheritance: Omitted channel/path/op inherit from the previous top-level delta; value never inherits. Values are kept separately per channel. Nested patch entries expand abbreviations without inheriting top-level fields.
delta_v1.paths: Empty path is root; optional leading slash; canonical decimal indices; ~1 and ~0 decode pointer escapes
delta_v1.append: Strings append text; arrays extend with an array or one scalar; objects shallow-merge; other targets replace
delta_v1.truncate: String length uses UTF-16 units; array length changes must be bounded
delta_v1.completion: EOF alone is incomplete. Terminal response and authoritative conversation state must establish outcome; handoff is not a finished response.

secondary_reference.limits: Its permissive patching and automatic recovery/fallback behavior are not adopted; current official codec exposes channel and operation inheritance that the new native parser must preserve.
